basis: Only baseline 5195c57 docs/TEXT_INQUIRY.md and docs/SEMANTICS.md operation/status contract; original frozen files are preserved unchanged.

changes.reason: Replacement of an existing source is an explicit operation; add cannot overwrite it.
With the sole source removed, its predicate may cease to be in the active signature. Both statuses express no current support; DEFER or SUPPORTED is not accepted.
Replacing the only source may remove the obsolete predicate from the active signature.
Removing the only source may remove its predicate from the active signature.
